channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump weighs ‘big decision’ on Iran, tanker hit in Hormuz
item.description: Trump says he faces a 'big decision' on whether to 'annihilate' his Iranian foes, adding that 'anything could happen'.

item.title: Trump administration approves sale of F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia
item.description: The deal, which needs approval from Congress, comes as Riyadh seeks Washington's help in its war with Yemen's Houthis.

item.title: US approves visas for top Iranian leaders to attend UN General Assembly
item.description: Iran's delegation to UNGA will be smaller this year, with travel restrictions and limits on luxury goods purchases.

item.title: Pennsylvania seeks CDC help amid dispute over US measles deaths
item.description: The CDC and officials from the US state differ over how four deaths should be classified as cases continue to spread.

item.title: Russia, China veto UN mandate to monitor Iran sanctions
item.description: Move ends the Security Council’s watchdog panel on Iran sanctions.

item.title: At least 26 killed in clashes along Sudan-South Sudan border region
item.description: UN Interim Security Force for Abyei strengthens security on the ground after days of deadly fighting.

item.title: Russia’s plans may include strikes against Ukraine’s allies, Poland says
item.description: Warsaw also says it scrambled military planes in response to a Russian attack in western Ukraine, close to its border.

item.title: Houthi leader denies targeting Mecca, vows to protect holy city
item.description: Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi pledges to defend Mecca and other Islamic holy sites.

item.title: Russia ‘sabotaging’ power supply lines at Zaporizhzhia plant: Greenpeace
item.description: Investigation finds no evidence of Russia's claims that Ukrainian attacks hit the nuclear power plant.

item.title: Third person dies from malaria in cluster near Germany’s Frankfurt Airport
item.description: Frankfurt grapples with a rare malaria outbreak tied to air travel, marking three deaths in recent months.
